decisions.reason: Although it is less central and only lightly promoted, it still fits the firm's biomass-to-nutrients logic and a growing, innovation-oriented firm would likely give a new consumer-facing product more time.
Modular waste-to-energy extensions are strongly aligned with the firm's established engineering and decentralized energy business, so management would usually retain them after only one year.
This product sits squarely in the firm's core waste-to-energy offering and its dedicated webpage suggests strategic importance and continued commitment.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is adjacent to the core business and promising, but its lower prominence and greater technical-commercial uncertainty make it somewhat more at risk than the main energy products.
